The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n     if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowCount(n, r, size);\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < rows; ++li) {\n            const double* src = &packed[displs[r] + li * n];\n            std::copy(src, src + n, full.begin() + (li * size + r) * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    const size_t rank = static_cast<size_t>(worldRank);\n    const size_t size = The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * row[k];\n            }\n            const double val = row[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                pivot[j + 1] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                row[j] = sqrt(val);\n                pivot[j + 1] = 0.0;\n            }\n            std::copy(row, row + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            double s1 = 0.0;\n            double s2 = 0.0;\n            double s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / diag;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / diag;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / diag;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / diag;\n        }\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.resize(nloc * n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[li * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        A[li * n + i] gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < std::copy(src, src + n, full.begin() + (li * size + r) * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_017ErUG6nakZ1m3F485Ncn3B","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * row[k];\n            }\n            const double val = row[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                pivot[j + 1] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                row[j] = sqrt(val);\n                pivot[j + 1] = 0.0;\n            }\n            std::copy(row, row + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            double s1 = 0.0;\n            double s2 = 0.0;\n            double s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / diag;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / diag;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / diag;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / diag;\n        }\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.resize(nloc * n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[li * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        A[li * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its own rows; row j of L is broadcast from its owner\n\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> Lj(n);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* Li = &L[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[li * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", errors[1]);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (errors[1] > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full row-major matrix on rank 0 (returns an empty vector on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowCount(n, r, size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    // Blocks arrive ordered by rank: rank r holds global rows r, r + size, ...\n    std::vector<double> packed(rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(A.data(), static_cast<int>(A.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(row[k], row[k], sum);\n            }\n            const double val = row[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                pivot[j + 1] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                row[j] = sqrt(val);\n                pivot[j + 1] = 0.0;\n            }\n            std::copy(row, row + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k.\n        // Products are fused explicitly (std::fma) so every row takes the same rounding path.\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            double s1 = 0.0;\n            double s2 = 0.0;\n            double s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 = std::fma(r0[k], p, s0);\n                s1 = std::fma(r1[k], p, s1);\n                s2 = std::fma(r2[k], p, s2);\n                s3 = std::fma(r3[k], p, s3);\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / diag;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / diag;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / diag;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / diag;\n        }\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.resize(nloc * n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[li * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        A[li * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its own rows; row j of L is broadcast from its owner\n\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> Lj(n);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* Li = &L[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[li * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", errors[1]);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (errors[1] > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full row-major matrix on rank 0 (returns an empty vector on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowCount(n, r, size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    // Blocks arrive ordered by rank: rank r holds global rows r, r + size, ...\n    std::vector<double> packed(rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(A.data(), static_cast<int>(A.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowCount(n, r, size);\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < rows; ++li) {\n            const double* src = &packed[displs[r] + li * n];\n            std::copy(src, src + n, full.begin() + (li * size + r) * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    const size_t rank = static_cast<size_t>(worldRank);\n    const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(worldSize);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Ranks: %zu\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (local rows)\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(seconds * 1000.0));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> L = gatherMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(L, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n, rank, size);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return 0;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":92,"oldLines":7,"newStart":92,"newLines":7,"lines":["             double* row = &A[li * n];","             double sum = 0.0;","             for (size_t k = 0; The diagonal dot product is fused explicitly, since the\n// sequential build fuses that one.\n#pragma GCC push_options\n#pragma GCC optimize(\"fp-contract=off\")\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition (MPI, row-cyclic distribution)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Global row i is owned by rank i % P and stored locally as row i / P, so each rank\n// holds roughly n/P rows. The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(row[k], row[k], sum);\n            }\n            const double val = row[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                pivot[j + 1] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                row[j] = sqrt(val);\n                pivot[j + 1] = 0.0;\n            }\n            std::copy(row, row + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k.\n        // Products are fused explicitly (std::fma) so every row takes the same rounding path.\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            double s1 = 0.0;\n            double s2 = 0.0;\n            double s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 = std::fma(r0[k], p, s0);\n                s1 = std::fma(r1[k], p, s1);\n                s2 = std::fma(r2[k], p, s2);\n                s3 = std::fma(r3[k], p, s3);\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / diag;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / diag;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / diag;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / diag;\n        }\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(row[k], pivot[k], sum);\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.resize(nloc * n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[li * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        A[li * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its own rows; row j of L is broadcast from its owner\n\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> Lj(n);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* Li = &L[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[li * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", errors[1]);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (errors[1] > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full row-major matrix on rank 0 (returns an empty vector on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// Contraction is disabled for the factorization so the off-diagonal sums round exactly as\n// the sequential build does. The diagonal dot product is fused explicitly, since the\n// sequential build fuses that one.\n#pragma GCC push_options\n#pragma GCC optimize(\"fp-contract=off\")\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(row[k], row[k], sum);\n            }\n            const double val = row[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                pivot[j + 1] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                row[j] = sqrt(val);\n                pivot[j + 1] = 0.0;\n            }\n            std::copy(row, row + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            double s1 = 0.0;\n            double s2 = 0.0;\n            double s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / diag;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / diag;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / diag;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / diag;\n        }\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum = std::fma(row[k], pivot[k], sum);\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.resize(nloc * n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[li * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        A[li * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its own rows; row j of L is broadcast from its owner\n\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> Lj(n);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* Li = &L[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[li * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", errors[1]);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (errors[1] > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full row-major matrix on rank 0 (returns an empty vector on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowCount(n, r, size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    // Blocks arrive ordered by rank: rank r holds global rows r, r + size, ...\n    std::vector<double> packed(rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(A.data(), static_cast<int>(A.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowCount(n, r, size);\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < rows; ++li) {\n            const double* src = &packed[displs[r] + li * n];\n            std::copy(src, src + n, full.begin() + (li * size + r) * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    const size_t rank = static_cast<size_t>(worldRank);\n    const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(worldSize);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Ranks: %zu\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (local rows)\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(seconds * 1000.0));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> L = gatherMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(L, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n, rank, size);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return 0;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":97,"oldLines":7,"newStart":97,"newLines":7,"lines":["             double* row = &A[li * n];","             double sum = 0.0;","             for (size_t k = 0; The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// Contraction is disabled for the factorization so the off-diagonal sums round exactly as\n// the sequential build does. The factorization runs column by column: the owner of row j\n// finishes the diagonal L[j][j] and broadcasts the prefix L[j][0..j], then every rank\n// computes L[i][j] for its own rows i > j. Each entry's dot product still accumulates\n// in ascending k, so results are bit-identical to the sequential row-oriented algorithm.\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are dealt cyclically over `size` ranks\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    return rank < n ? (n - rank + size - 1) / size : 0;\n}\n\n// Floating-point contraction is disabled for the factorization so every dot product is a\n// plain ascending-k sum of rounded products, the same arithmetic as the sequential code.\n#pragma GCC push_options\n#pragma GCC optimize(\"fp-contract=off\")\n\n// A holds this rank's rows in row-major order (localRowCount(n, rank, size) rows of length n)\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Broadcast buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            double* row = &A[(j / size) * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * row[k];\n            }\n            const double val = row[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                pivot[j + 1] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                row[j] = sqrt(val);\n                pivot[j + 1] = 0.0;\n            }\n            std::copy(row, row + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Off-diagonal entries of column j for the local rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = pivot[j];\n        size_t li = (j < rank) ? 0 : (j - rank) / size + 1;\n\n        // Four rows at a time: independent accumulators hide FP add latency,\n        // and each row still sums its terms in ascending k\n        for (; li + 4 <= nloc; li += 4) {\n            double* r0 = &A[li * n];\n            double* r1 = r0 + n;\n            double* r2 = r1 + n;\n            double* r3 = r2 + n;\n            double s0 = 0.0;\n            double s1 = 0.0;\n            double s2 = 0.0;\n            double s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double p = pivot[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * p;\n                s1 += r1[k] * p;\n                s2 += r2[k] * p;\n                s3 += r3[k] * p;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / diag;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / diag;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / diag;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / diag;\n        }\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pivot[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / diag;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[li * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n#pragma GCC pop_options\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (each rank computes only its own rows)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.resize(nloc * n);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[li * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = li * size + rank;\n        A[li * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its own rows; row j of L is broadcast from its owner\n\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> Lj(n);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* Li = &L[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[li * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", errors[1]);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (errors[1] > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full row-major matrix on rank 0 (returns an empty vector on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowCount(n, r, size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    // Blocks arrive ordered by rank: rank r holds global rows r, r + size, ...\n    std::vector<double> packed(rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(A.data(), static_cast<int>(A.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowCount(n, r, size);\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < rows; ++li) {\n            const double* src = &packed[displs[r] + li * n];\n            std::copy(src, src + n, full.begin() + (li * size + r) * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    const size_t rank = static_cast<size_t>(worldRank);\n    const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(worldSize);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; row j of L is broadcast from its owner\n\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> Lj(n);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % size;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const double* row = &L[(j / size) * n];\n            std::copy(row, row + n, Lj.begin());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(Lj.data(), static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            const double* Li = &L[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * Lj[k];\n            }\n\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[li * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[li * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", errors[0]);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", errors[1]);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (errors[1] > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full row-major matrix on rank 0 (returns an empty vector on other ranks)\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t size) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(size);\n    std::vector<int> displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowCount(n, r, size) * n);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    // Blocks arrive ordered by rank: rank r holds global rows r, r + size, ...\n    std::vector<double> packed(rank == 0 ? n * n : 0);\n    MPI_Gatherv(A.data(), static_cast<int>(A.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                packed.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const size_t rows = localRowCount(n, r, size);\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < rows; ++li) {\n            const double* src = &packed[displs[r] + li * n];\n            std::copy(src, src + n, full.begin() + (li * size + r) * n);\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    const size_t rank = static_cast<size_t>(worldRank);\n    const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(worldSize);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Ranks: %zu\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (local rows)\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(seconds * 1000.0));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> L = gatherMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(L, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n, rank, size);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return 0;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":7,"newStart":17,"newLines":8,"lines":[" // holds roughly n/P rows. Column j's diagonal is finished by its owner, which broadcasts the row prefix; every rank then updates its own rows below the diagonal. Each dot product still sums in ascending k.\n- **Generation and validation:** each rank builds only its rows of `A = B·Bᵀ`. The random matrix `B` is still generated on every rank, so it stays identical to the original. Validation runs distributed, and its max-reductions are exact.\n- **`-r`:** the full matrix is gathered to rank 0 only for printing.\n- **Build:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable name is still `cholesky`.\n\n**Decisions for you to review**\n\n1. **`-ffp-contract=off` added to CMake.** Without it, GCC fuses some multiply-adds, and the fused pattern changes with loop trip counts, so no single source-level fix reproduces it. With the flag, the output is deterministic and matches the original built with the same flag. The trade-off is that the hash changes against the original's default build: n=512 gives `17e5a1797bab7ba5` instead of `218815f54287577a`. The difference is in the last bits; validation still passes with a max relative error around 1e-14. If you need the old hashes exactly, tell me and I'll replicate GCC's vectorized reduction order.\n2. **Output changes:** I added a `Ranks:` line. GFLOPS is now computed from the measured seconds, so it no longer prints `inf` when the run takes under 1 ms.\n\n**Not verified**\n\n- I tested with one-node Open MPI and oversubscription, not a real multi-node cluster.\n- The \"not positive definite\" path is reviewed but not exercised. The generated matrix is always positive definite, so the CLI can't trigger it.\n\nBuilds were done in `/tmp`.
